name: MoisesDB
description: A multitrack music dataset for music source separation, with aligned audio stems and mixes. Unlike the legacy GTZAN genre-recognition baseline, which has known flaws, MoisesDB is designed for source-separation research.
citation: MoisesDB: A Dataset for Source Separation. ISMIR 2023. https://archives.ismir.net/ismir2023/
